verdict.rationale: Clara documents a dedicated sandbox environment for testing integrations end-to-end without affecting real data or triggering real financial operations (clara-docs-8). The sandbox is isolated from production, supports webhook subscriptions, and can send test events on demand via `POST /api-test/v3/webhooks/events` (clara-docs-30, clara-docs-9). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and details on obtaining sandbox credentials and test data seeding.
